sourceNote: ElectionsIreland.org files this contest under its later area name "Ballyfermot" (cons 15). In 1974 Dublin Corporation was elected in nine numbered areas, set by the Dublin County Borough (Electoral Areas) Order, 1974 (S.I. No. 28 of 1974); this is Dublin City Number Six, the area named for Ballyfermot, filed under IrelandElection.com's name for it.
